caption: Shaadi ka invitation... abhi bhi PDF mein?!
Toh milo WowLink se! Haath se bana, animated invitation, bas ek link mein!
Occasion chuno, naam likho, aur publish! Bas!
Mehmaan link kholte hain, aur invitation sach mein khulta hai!
Countdown! Calendar! Aur ek tap mein RSVP!
Gujarati, Hindi ya English, aapki marzi!
Aur saare jawaab, ek hi jagah!
Toh der kis baat ki? Apna pehla invitation free mein banao!
